description: Restore OpenCode CLI-backed model and reasoning-variant discovery, move catalog ownership to RunnerHost, and make OpenCode runtime readiness independent of best-effort model discovery without changing runner-to-server or Web contracts.

tasks.title: Implement the OpenCode CLI model-catalog adapter
tasks.description: Restore a standalone runner model-discovery module that selects the configured OpenCode executable, synchronously captures complete `opencode models --verbose` stdout, and returns model IDs plus exact `variants` object keys. Keep the adapter always-executing and best-effort, with tolerant block parsing, empty failure normalization, order-insensitive catalog equality, and an injected command runner for deterministic tests.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/runner/src/runtime/opencode-models.ts` exposes a Mohist-owned `{ models: string[], variants: Record<string, string[]> }` result, parser, discovery function, order-insensitive equality helper, and command-runner test seam.

Discovery selects `MOHIST_AGENT_MODELS_COMMAND`, then `MOHIST_AGENT_COMMAND`, then `opencode`, and invokes the selected executable with `models --verbose` on every call; tests prove consecutive calls execute independently and no time-based cache exists.

The production adapter checks the external-process policy and synchronously drains UTF-8 stdout with bounded timeout and buffer settings before parsing; focused tests feed output larger than the previously observed 49 KB boundary and prove trailing models and variants are retained without starting a real process.

Parser tests use the explicit `^([^/\s]+)/(\S+)$` header grammar and cover additional slashes, flat valid-header lists, ignored warning/diagnostic lines, single-line and multiline JSON metadata, braces and escapes inside strings, exact provider-defined variant keys, and missing/empty/non-object variants.

Concrete malformed-output tests prove balanced-invalid metadata resumes after its block, unbalanced metadata resumes at the next valid header without consuming it, and output with no valid header returns empty models and variants; missing executable, abort, and non-zero exit are likewise logged and normalized without throwing, and a later invocation can succeed.
Equality tests prove model order and per-model variant order are ignored while added/removed models, variant-map keys, or variant values are detected as changes.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` and `npm test -w packages/runner` pass with no real OpenCode process, network, filesystem, or wall-clock wait in the new tests.
tasks.output: A tested `packages/runner/src/runtime/opencode-models.ts` CLI catalog adapter that returns complete model and reasoning-variant data without caching.
tasks.notes: This is the independently usable discovery component from design D1/D2. Do not wire RunnerHost or retain an SDK fallback in this task. Reuse the established synchronous capture limits and process-policy boundary rather than introducing a dependency.

tasks.title: Switch runner discovery and readiness to the new ownership model
tasks.description: Atomically switch RunnerHost to own startup and periodic CLI discovery while preserving registration, refresh, failure-retention, and immediate-heartbeat behavior. In the same task, remove all catalog state and APIs from OpenCodeRuntime so readiness reflects only the shared server lifecycle and health, migrate affected fakes/tests, and align the authoritative OpenCode runtime design document.
acceptanceCriteria: `design/runtimes/opencode.md` removes SDK catalog operations and catalog-gated readiness, assigns best-effort CLI discovery to RunnerHost, and no longer lists CLI model parsing as retired behavior; adjacent source comments express the same ownership.

`OpenCodeRuntimeDeps` has no `catalogFactory`; `OpenCodeRuntime` has no catalog state, `catalog()`, or `refreshCatalog()`; `RuntimeModelCatalog`, `RuntimeModelDescriptor`, `catalog.ts`, factory wiring, exports, and catalog-only diagnostics are removed without compatibility aliases.

Runtime tests prove `ready()` becomes true after server startup, health, and event-subscription setup without catalog discovery; spawn and health failures still gate work with actionable diagnostics, and server loss still flips readiness false, fails affected work without replay, rebuilds, and recovers after health alone.

RunnerHost performs one best-effort CLI discovery before its first registration and reads registration state directly from host-owned `coderModels` and `coderModelVariants`; a failed initial discovery registers empty fields but a healthy runtime continues polling and claiming work.

Periodic discovery runs independently of `runtime.ready()` at the configured cadence with a 30-minute default and 60-second floor; the timer is registered after startup discovery, first registration, and startup convergence, first fires one interval after that registration, and is cleared when the run loop terminates. Fake-timer specs cover the registration clock origin and prove connection/convergence delay is excluded from the interval.

An empty or failed rediscovery preserves the last non-empty snapshot and sends no clearing heartbeat; non-empty catalogs compare order-insensitively, unchanged catalogs send no extra heartbeat, and model-only or variant-only changes update both host fields and attempt one immediate heartbeat through the existing channel.
Registration and heartbeat continue to use only the existing `coderModels` and `coderModelVariants` fields; no Server, CLI, or Web production contract or persistence schema changes are introduced.

Shared runtime and host test support contains no catalog fixtures or SDK catalog calls, and all discovery/process/time behavior is driven by injected fakes and fake timers rather than real process, network, filesystem, or wall-clock dependencies.

Existing Web selector tests for Issue defaults/stages, AI settings defaults/stages, shared model chips, and create/agent model selection remain green, proving populated variant maps still render selectable chips, persist active variants, support model-only selection, and clear selections.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` and `npm test -w packages/runner` pass; the targeted existing Web selector tests pass with `npm run test:run -w packages/web`.
tasks.output: RunnerHost-backed CLI model discovery with health-only OpenCodeRuntime readiness, unchanged registration contracts, aligned architecture documentation, and passing runner plus selector regression tests.
tasks.notes: Host switchover and runtime catalog removal are one task because each consumes the other's boundary change; splitting them would leave an uncompilable or compatibility-only intermediate state. Key areas: `runtime/host.ts`, `runtime/opencode/`, `core/types.ts`, runner test support, and `design/runtimes/opencode.md`. Do not modify Server/Web production code or add a second discovery source.
